What changed in this PR Adds an opt-in ARM linter rule for resource-group path parameters, corresponding to the Swagger `PathContainsResourceGroup` check without changing default lint behavior. **Changes:** - Checks concrete ARM GET, PUT, PATCH, and DELETE paths for the canonical resource-group parameter. - Registers the rule while leaving it disabled in ARM `all` and Azure resource-manager rulesets. - Adds behavioral and opt-in tests, author guidance, reference listings, and changelog entries. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `website/​src/​content/​docs/​docs/​libraries/​azure-resource-manager/​reference/​linter.md` | Lists the new rule in the website reference. | | `website/​src/​content/​docs/​docs/​howtos/​ARM/​arm-rules.md` | Documents Swagger equivalence, impact, and default enablement. | | `packages/​typespec-azure-rulesets/​test/​validate-rules-defined.test.ts` | Verifies the rule remains opt-in. | | `packages/​typespec-azure-rulesets/​src/​rulesets/​resource-manager.ts` | Explicitly disables the rule in the resource-manager ruleset. | | `packages/​typespec-azure-resource-manager/​test/​rules/​resource-group-path-parameter.test.ts` | Covers path matching, operation scope, templates, and diagnostic targets. | | `packages/​typespec-azure-resource-manager/​test/​linter.test.ts` | Tests exclusion from ARM `all` and explicit activation. | | `packages/​typespec-azure-resource-manager/​src/​rules/​resource-group-path-parameter.ts` | Implements the resource-group path check. | | `packages/​typespec-azure-resource-manager/​src/​rules/​resource-group-path-parameter.md` | Explains applicability, configuration, corrections, and suppression. | | `packages/​typespec-azure-resource-manager/​src/​linter.ts` | Registers the rule without enabling it by default. | | `packages/​typespec-azure-resource-manager/​README.md` | Adds the rule to the package reference. | | `.chronus/​changes/​rulesets-resource-group-path-parameter-2026-10-27.md` | Records the ruleset registration change. | | `.chronus/​changes/​arm-resource-group-path-parameter-2026-10-27.md` | Announces the new opt-in lint rule. |
